data.name: Upayan
data.long_meaning: Upayan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'upa' which means near or towards, and 'ayan' which means vehicle, thus Upayan means 'one who guides or leads towards'. This name is also associated with the god Vishnu who is considered the preserver of the universe and the one who guides souls towards the path of righteousness.
